description: Convert decimal hours (8.75) to hours:minutes:seconds (8:45:00) and back. Built for timesheets, payroll and work-hour tracking.

faqs.a: Time expressed as a fraction of an hour: 8.5 hours = 8 hours 30 minutes. Payroll systems and timesheets commonly use it.

faqs.q: How do I convert 45 minutes to decimal hours?
faqs.a: Divide by 60: 45 ÷ 60 = 0.75 hours. This tool does it both ways live.

faqs.q: What formats does the H:MM input accept?
faqs.a: H:MM or H:MM:SS, for example 8:45 or 8:45:30. Either direction updates the other field instantly.

howto: Type decimal hours (e.g. 8.75) to see H:MM:SS instantly.
Or type H:MM or H:MM:SS (e.g. 8:45) to see decimal hours.
Both fields stay in sync as you type.
Use the totals for minutes, seconds and fraction of a day.
title: Decimal Time Converter
